name: Subway
observations: Bright green fascia with large white/yellow SUBWAY lettering.
Broad lower glazing and a narrower door bay, dark/light frame contrast and brick plinth.
Upper red brick has tall vertically proportioned dark-framed windows with pale lintels/sills.
Roof height/upper-window proportions differ from the lower charity-shop row to the south.
Native154 shows a small projecting upper bay immediately beside this area; preserve relief in shared upper mass.
Roadside lamp column and vehicles obscure part of the sign/window; use overlapping views.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
